officialKey.visualReview: The original UPSC-hosted four-page PDF was downloaded, hashed and page 1 rendered. All 150 Series A cells were independently read by columns and then by rows; both transcriptions agree. The handwritten (I) above the heading identifies the examination session; printed Paper II means GAT, not NDA session II. Original question-paper cover identifies Series A. No option reordering.
officialKey.priorSearchCorrection: The key was not in the current Answer Keys or archive listings. A historical release reference identified the unusual en dash in the official filename. Prior statements that no matching official key could be recovered were incomplete, not evidence that UPSC had not released one.

records.editorialCaveat: UPSC accepts Adjective. Some modern grammatical frameworks analyse half as a determiner; the examination answer is retained separately from that terminology caveat.
UPSC accepts unless. Till and until can also produce grammatical sentences with a time-condition reading; the official provisional answer is used, without claiming the other readings are impossible.

records.editorialCaveat: Official provisional key A supersedes our previously published reasoned C. The printed moving-frame wording raises a Galilean kinetic-energy-change objection; that disagreement is recorded rather than silently substituting our answer for UPSC’s examination answer.
The official proportionality assumes the usual rest-start model. Without that assumption constant power gives v²=v₀²+2Pt/m. Original wording is retained.
